issue_context.title: Add a metric to track number of scheduler binding goroutines
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
Add a metric to track number of scheduler binding goroutines. This will be a generic metric `scheduler_goroutines_total` with `binding` as the only label for now.

metric name | metric definition | Description
-- | -- | --
scheduler_goroutines | Type: Gauge Label: work={"binding"}| Number of running binding goroutines

**Why is this needed**:
Helps us track how many binding are running and monitor issues such as goroutine leak.

/sig scheduling

review_comments:
We create a lot of goroutines in the following methods

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/00458855e487b36ec7356038c6dc7e10a5354018/pkg/scheduler/core/generic_scheduler.go#L681-L689
Yes, I am more willing to add more stages than just binding.
